Why can people with low bad cholesterol still have heart attacks?
articles.description: A study has uncovered a concerning relationship between lipoproteins, particularly triglyceride-rich lipoproteins and lipoprotein(a), and the risk of developing coronary artery disease. Analyzing nearly 3,000 blood proteins, it revealed key differences in protein patterns compared to LDL cholesterol. The results underscore the importance of inflammation and vascular changes in coronary artery disease progression, indicating the necessity for additional research to better understand these proteins' influence on cardiovascular health.

articles.title: Christie’s Auction Withdrawal: Christie’s pulled Kahlo painting; 1953 return complicates export claims
articles.description: In a surprising turn of events, a rare Frida Kahlo painting was pulled from a New York auction at Christie’s. The auction house raised concerns over the artwork's ownership provenance, especially its ties to Kahlo's iconic Casa Azul. Mexican officials are now on the hunt for necessary documentation to verify its legal status, with Christie’s optimistic about reintroducing the piece after thorough investigations.

Bristol's 600-year-old Ashton Court Mansion could finally be restored after councillors backed a 125-year lease to a community trust, but the group has raised only £125,000 toward its early funding target
articles.description: Ashton Court Mansion, a historic building in Bristol, has been neglected and is in poor condition. The Bristol City Council has approved a 125-year lease for the Ashton Court Mansion Trust. The trust aims to restore the mansion and enhance community access, with a financial target of £480,000. They have raised £125,000 through a community share offer, showcasing public interest in the project.

articles.title: NLC India Executive Recruitment 2026: Notification out for 145 posts, applications begin today
articles.description: NLC India Limited has announced 145 Executive vacancies under Advertisement No. 11/2026 across E1 to E7 grades. Positions include Deputy General Manager, Executive Engineer, Manager and Deputy Manager in engineering, HR, legal and other disciplines. Online registration begins on November 20, 2026, and closes on December 19. Selection will involve a Computer-Based Test carrying 80 marks and an interview carrying 20 marks. Annual CTC ranges from approximately Rs. 14.50 lakh to Rs. 29.02 lakh.

articles.title: Maharashtra TET 2026: Re-examination likely in January or February, government approval awaited
articles.description: The Maharashtra State Council of Examination is planning to conduct the cancelled TET 2026 examination in January or February 2027. The June 28 examination was cancelled following reports of a paper leak, affecting more than two lakh registered candidates. The council has approached the state government for approval and explored conducting the test online through IBPS. However, multilingual examination arrangements remain a challenge. The revised examination schedule is yet to receive official approval.

articles.title: CHSE Odisha Class 12 time table 2027 released: Theory exams begin February 16; check complete schedule
articles.description: CHSE Odisha has released the timetable for the Annual Higher Secondary Examination 2027 for Class 12 students. Practical examinations are scheduled from January 4 to January 16, 2027, while theory examinations commence on February 16, 2027. Students should prepare for various subjects including Arts, Science, Commerce, and Vocational streams during this period. Theory exams will conclude on March 31, 2027, with varying timings for different papers.

articles.title: UPPSC PCS 2026: When will the Preliminary admit card be released?
articles.description: UPPSC PCS Admit Card 2026: UPPSC is expected to release the PCS 2026 Preliminary Examination admit card in November ahead of the December 6 examination. The Commission has not confirmed the exact release date as of November 20. The preliminary examination will comprise two General Studies papers, carrying 200 marks each. Candidates will be able to download their e-Admit Cards through uppsc.up.nic.in using the required registration details. The document will contain examination centre and candidate identification information.

articles.title: ‘Bouma’ BO: Malayalam film sees 38.9% drop, earns Rs 33 lakh
articles.description: Bouma, released on November 12, has seen a drop in box-office collections since its opening. The film earned Rs 33 lakh on Day 8, resulting in a total India net collection of Rs 6.55 crore. Initially, it opened with Rs 50 lakh, increasing collections over the opening weekend and reaching Rs 1.50 crore on Day 4. However, its performance has gradually decreased during the weekdays post opening weekend.

articles.title: Films faced backlash: Ramayana boycott call revives scrutiny
articles.description: Ahead of Nitesh Tiwari’s ‘Ramayana’, which faces boycott calls from the Hindu Janajagruti Samiti, here are eight Indian films that courted controversy: ‘Padmaavat’, ‘Bajirao Mastani’, ‘Jodhaa Akbar’, ‘Ram-Leela’, ‘PK’, ‘Ae Dil Hai Mushkil’ and ‘Pathaan’. Despite protests, bans and title changes, each eventually reached theatres.
